scope: 2025 U.S. federal calendar-year, own ordinary traditional IRA conversion; timely, valid, nondeductible regular contribution. Own taxable compensation only. Other regular IRA contributions are Roth contributions already independently determined eligible, not deductible traditional contributions. All own traditional, traditional SEP and traditional SIMPLE IRA year-end balances across custodians are aggregated; spouse IRAs and employer plans are excluded. No other IRA distributions, tax withholding from the conversion, RMD obligation, outstanding rollovers, rollovers into or out of traditional IRAs, special repayments, qualified charitable/HSA distributions, recharacterizations, excess corrections, inherited IRAs, SIMPLE conversions, annuity valuation adjustments, disaster relief, nonresident/treaty or community-property issues. Following-year contributions were designated for 2025 and made by April 15, 2026. Basis and account values are supplied assumptions, not authenticated records.
rounding: Exact capped pro-rata fraction; round the allocated amount once to cents, ties up. This is an allocation estimate, not a completed Form 8606. IRS decimal-ratio and filing rounding may differ.

authority_assessments.rationale: 2025 only. Regular traditional and Roth contributions share the annual limit. Compensation is checked separately; no spousal compensation rule is modeled. Independent tax-professional and formalization review pending.
Age at the end of 2025; the catch-up limit is 8000 dollars, not the different 2026 limit. Independent tax-professional and formalization review pending.

A conditional amount-limit check. Scope supplies timely eligible contributions and designation as nondeductible. No deduction, direct-Roth MAGI test, spousal IRA rule, or overall tax optimization is inferred. Independent tax-professional and formalization review pending.

Prior basis is supplied from records, never inferred to be zero from missing Form 8606. Scope excludes basis adjustments and other current-year deductible traditional contributions. Independent tax-professional and formalization review pending.

2025-designated contributions made January 1 through April 15, 2026 are removed from basis available for 2025 conversions. No disaster-deadline relief is modeled. Independent tax-professional and formalization review pending.

Scope requires the owner's combined traditional, traditional SEP and traditional SIMPLE IRA balances at all custodians. No spouse's IRA or employer 401(k) balance. Line 7 and special line 6 adjustments are zero by explicit scope assumption. Independent tax-professional and formalization review pending.

Exact rational allocation capped at one, then rounded once to nearest cent with ties up. This is an allocation estimate, not a completed Form 8606: the form permits a decimal ratio rounded to at least three places and filing rounding can differ. The arithmetic convention is explicit and requires independent formalization review. Independent tax-professional and formalization review pending.

Amount included in income estimate, not tax owed. Rates, penalties, credits, Medicare effects, state taxes and future Roth withdrawals are outside scope. Independent tax-professional and formalization review pending.

Includes 2025-designated contributions made in early 2026. No other distributions or adjustments; shares the allocation rounding convention. Independent tax-professional and formalization review pending.
